claims: The 2026 World Baseball Classic enforces a 65-pitch limit in pool play.
The 2026 World Baseball Classic enforces an 80-pitch limit in the quarterfinals.
The 2026 World Baseball Classic enforces a 95-pitch limit in the semifinals and championship.
Pitchers can finish a batter's plate appearance if they reach the pitch limit mid-at-bat in the 2026 World Baseball Classic.
Pitchers who throw 30 or more pitches require at least one day of rest in the 2026 World Baseball Classic.
Pitchers who throw 50 or more pitches require at least four days of rest in the 2026 World Baseball Classic.
If a pitcher works two consecutive days in the 2026 World Baseball Classic, they must have a rest day.
The 2026 World Baseball Classic has a three-batter minimum rule for pitchers.
In the 2026 World Baseball Classic, pitchers have 15 seconds to throw with bases empty.
In the 2026 World Baseball Classic, pitchers have 18 seconds to throw with runners on.
The 2026 World Baseball Classic occurs during the MLB pre-season.
During the MLB pre-season, pitchers are not fully built up.
